description: Upload a finalized track or release asset from a local file. `track_stereo` (WAV/FLAC/AIFF), `track_dolby` (Dolby Atmos WAV) and `track_lyrics` (LRC) process asynchronously — check state with get_asset (mode info). `release_cover_art` uploads or replaces the static cover art image. `release_motion_square`/`release_motion_tall` upload the animated cover (motion artwork) video, also asynchronous. All assets become immutable once the release is distributed — upload final files first.

file_path.description: Local path to the file to upload.

id.description: The track or release id, per `target`.

name: upload_asset
title: Upload a release/track asset
